chat.help.targets.windowTitleDocked.body: Settings for this chat, beside it. The chat makes room for them. Edit picks which sections show, their order and the pane's width.
chat.holdTip.body: Hold any message to regenerate, edit, copy or branch it, and to see its other versions.
chat.holdTip.title: Hold a message for more
chat.memoryRecall.wholeChat.description: Off: recalls only older messages that no longer fit in the prompt, and adds nothing while the whole chat fits. On: may also recall messages the prompt already holds.
chat.memoryRecall.wholeChat.label: Recall from the whole chat
chat.setupPage.conversationIntro: Pick who you're messaging and how they talk, then press Start. Everything here stays editable in Chat settings.
chat.setupPage.conversationMore: Messages and commands · Custom prompt · Parameters
chat.setupPage.needsCharacter: Add someone to message to start
chat.setupPage.rememberChoices: Remember these choices for this preset
chat.setupPage.roleplayIntro: Pick who's in it and how the story is told, then press Start. Everything here stays editable in Chat settings.
chat.setupPage.startFailed: Couldn't start the chat. Please try again.
chatSettings.advanced.imageCaptioningAut: Off here, but the Image reading model still describes this chat's pictures when its own model can't see them.
connections.add.decisionNote: Decision models make small yes-or-no checks for agents and the Illustrator, such as whether a scene needs a picture.
connections.add.typeToUse: Type a model ID to use this
connections.defaults.purpose.decision: Small yes-or-no checks for agents and the Illustrator
connections.defaults.purpose.embeddings: Finds old messages and lore by meaning
connections.defaults.purpose.impersonate: Writes a message as you when you ask
connections.defaults.purpose.main: Writes the replies in your chats
connections.defaults.purpose.mari: Answers you in Professor Mari's chat
connections.defaults.purpose.stt: Turns what you say into text
connections.editor.maxOutputTokensHelp: The longest reply this connection may write, in tokens. Automatic uses the model's own limit, or 8,192 tokens when Marinara doesn't know the model. A chat can ask for less in its Advanced Parameters, never more. Professor Mari writes up to this limit, so if her replies get cut off, raise it; 32000 suits most current models.
connections.editor.workflowCheck.blanksE: Slots without a picture stay empty. Turn on the 1x1 placeholder in this model's settings to fill them.
connections.editor.workflowCheck.blanksF: Slots without a picture get the blank placeholder.
connections.editor.workflowCheck.literal: Node {{node}} loads "{{file}}" every time. It is a saved file, not a placeholder.
Node {{node}} loads "{{file}}" every time. Replace it with {{placeholder}} to send a reference there.
connections.editor.workflowCheck.noRefer: No reference slots, so character pictures are not sent to this workflow.
connections.editor.workflowCheck.title: Workflow check
connections.editor.workflowCheck.uiForma: This is an editor save. Export it with Save (API format) so ComfyUI can run it.
connections.imageReading.limitsHint: Blank uses the built-in value. A thinking model spends part of the answer length thinking, so give it more room or turn its thinking off. A Max output tokens limit on the Model still applies.
connections.imageReading.promptHint: Sent as the system prompt with every picture. A chat can use its own in Chat settings › Advanced Parameters.
connections.imageReading.requestHint: Sent with each picture. {{filename}} becomes the picture's file name.
connections.imageReading.title: What it's asked
featureFinder.groupChats.name: Group chats
featureFinder.groupChats.summary: Add two or more characters to one chat. One narrator voices everyone by default, or each character replies in turn.
featureFinder.instruct.name: Instruct and context templates
featureFinder.instruct.summary: Not needed here: Marinara sends chat messages and the model's server applies its own template. A preset lays out the prompt.
featureFinder.presets.name: Presets
featureFinder.presets.summary: The prompt the AI gets, as sections in order, plus starting sampler settings such as temperature. Library > Presets.
featureFinder.regexScripts.name: Regex scripts
featureFinder.regexScripts.summary: Find-and-replace rules for what the AI writes or what you send, for every chat or one character.
game.setupLore.bookEmpty: This lorebook has no enabled entries.
game.setupLore.bookError: Could not load this lorebook's entries.
imageSettings.canvases.intro: The size each kind of picture asks for, in pixels from 64 to 4096. A model may round it: NovelAI uses multiples of 64 and about one megapixel at most.
imageSettings.canvases.spritesNote: Sprites have no size here. They use a fixed grid: 512 × 512 per face, 1024 × 1536 for a sheet.
imageSettings.defaults.generationsNote: Queueing, prompt review and WebP stay in Settings > Generations, because video uses them too.
imageSettings.defaults.imagesJobHint: The model that draws pictures when a chat or agent has not picked one, and the one to try if it fails. The same setting as Connections > Jobs > Images.
imageSettings.defaults.modelOptionsHint: The Images model's own style, prompt prefixes and drawing settings. They apply wherever this model draws.
imageSettings.defaults.uses.gallery: Avatars, character sheets and gallery pictures
imageSettings.defaults.uses.galleryRule: Images, or the model you pick each time
imageSettings.defaults.uses.illustratorR: The chat's pick, else the Illustrator setup's, else Images
imageSettings.defaults.uses.selfiesRule: The chat's pick, else Images once selfies are on
imageSettings.defaults.uses.trackerPortr: Only the model picked in the Character Tracker
imageSettings.defaults.writerIllustrator: The chat's Prompt Model, else the Illustrator setup's model, else the chat's own model.
imageSettings.defaults.writerSelfies: The chat's Prompt Model, else the chat's own model, else Main.
imageSettings.generations.intro: Styles, picture sizes and prompt templates are in Library > Settings profiles > Image settings.
imageSettings.generations.promptOverride: Reusable video prompt templates. Image templates are in Library > Settings profiles > Image settings.
imageSettings.meta: Every chat · used when a chat or agent hasn't picked its own
imageSettings.prompts.intro: Templates that build a prompt without a writer, or tell the writer what to do. Video templates stay in Settings > Generations.
imageSettings.styles.intro: A style profile is a reusable look. Its style text goes to the prompt writer; its tags go straight into the final prompt.
imageSettings.styles.order: Which style is used: the game setup's style, then the chat's Image Style, then the image model's own style, then the default style below.
imageSettings.styles.perImageHint: Added only for this kind of picture.
imageSettings.title: Image settings
settings.features.newLorebookVectors.hel: New lorebooks start with Vectors on, so their entries can be vectorized and found by meaning. When off, new lorebooks match by keywords only until you turn on Vectors in the lorebook. Existing lorebooks keep their own setting.
settings.search.alwaysShowMessageButtons: Show every message's buttons all the time, not only when the mouse is over it.
ui.agents.regexscripteditor.applyModeSav: Not needed. The saved message itself is changed.
ui.cards.appearanceImageTags.imageTagsHi: Kept, but not used. Image prompts fall back to Prose.
ui.cards.appearanceImageTags.proseHint: Image prompts and the narrator both read this.
ui.cards.appearanceImageTags.proseHintTa: The narrator reads this. Image prompts use the Image tags tab.
ui.cards.imagesTab.imageTagsNote: Image tags for image prompts sit next to Appearance on the Card tab.
ui.chat.imageregeneratepanel.img2imgHint: Image-to-image mode: re-draws the image using the prompt below. Paint a mask over the image to switch to inpainting.
ui.chat.imageregeneratepanel.img2imgStre: How much the image can change from the original. Around 0.30–0.50 keeps the pose and shifts lighting or details; 0.60+ redraws more of the scene.
ui.chat.imageregeneratepanel.infillStren: How strongly the masked area is redrawn. 1.00 fully replaces what is under the mask; lower values blend with the original pixels.
ui.chat.imageregeneratepanel.inpaintingH: Inpainting mode: redraws only the masked area while keeping the rest of the image intact.
ui.chat.imageregeneratepanel.noiseHelp: Extra random detail added before redrawing. Leave at 0.00 for clean edits; small values (0.05–0.20) help add new textures when Strength is low.
ui.chat.imageregeneratepanel.referencesO: Recorded character and location reference images are omitted during image edits.
ui.chat.nextImage.noWorkflowSlots: the workflow has no slot for them
ui.chat.nextImage.referencesBoth: Sent to the image model and the prompt writer
ui.chat.nextImage.skipped: {{source}} pick can't be used right now, so this one draws.
ui.chat.nextImage.title: Next image in this chat
ui.chat.nextImage.writerMissing: The chosen Prompt Model can't be used right now, so the Illustrator is skipped.
ui.chat.nextImage.writerMissingSelfie: The chosen Prompt Model can't be used right now, so selfies fail.
ui.import.streport.authorsNoteOff: The Author's Note was turned off in SillyTavern, so it stays off.
ui.import.streport.authorsNotePlacement: Author's Note kept. SillyTavern used a different frequency, position or role for it; Marinara adds it to every message at the same depth.
ui.import.streport.bulkAuthorsNotesOff_o: {{count}} chat had its Author's Note turned off in SillyTavern; it stays off.
{{count}} chats had their Author's Note turned off in SillyTavern; it stays off.
ui.import.streport.bulkAuthorsNotesPlace: {{count}} of those had a different frequency, position or role in SillyTavern; Marinara adds the note to every message at the same depth.
{{count}} of those had a different frequency, position or role in SillyTavern; Marinara adds the note to every message at the same depth.
ui.import.streport.bulkPersonas_one: {{count}} chat is linked to its persona.
ui.import.streport.bulkPersonas_other: {{count}} chats are linked to their persona.
ui.import.streport.bulkPersonasMissing: No persona with these names, so their chats have none: {{names}}. Make the persona, then pick it in Chat settings.
ui.import.streport.bulkPresetSettings_on: {{count}} preset brought its sampler settings along.
ui.import.streport.bulkPresetSettings_ot: {{count}} presets brought their sampler settings along.
ui.import.streport.outOfRange: A setting outside Marinara's range was left out.
ui.import.streport.personaMissing: No persona named “{{name}}”, so the chat has none. Make a persona with that name, then pick it in Chat settings.
ui.import.streport.settingsImported: Settings brought along: {{names}}. A connection's or chat's own values still win.
ui.import.streport.sizesOnConnection: Max response length and context size stay on your connection.
ui.import.streport.unsupported: No setting for these here, so they were left out: {{names}}.
ui.modals.createlorebookmodal.vectorsHel: When on, entries can also be found by meaning once vectorized. When off, keywords still work. New lorebooks start the way Settings > Advanced > Lorebooks > "Vectors on for new lorebooks" says.
ui.modals.stbulkimportmodal.browseOpened: Marinara can only browse folders inside your home folder, so the browser opened there. Move the SillyTavern folder into it if it isn't.
ui.overhaul.messagebuttons.alwaysShowHel: With a mouse, every message shows its buttons all the time, not only while the pointer is over it. On phones and tablets, hold a message for its buttons.
ui.overhaul.profiles.builtInCopy: Duplicate it to make a copy you can change.
ui.overhaul.profiles.pick: Pick a profile on the left, or make a new one.
ui.overhaul.profiles.seeAllInLibrary: See all profiles in the Library
ui.overhaul.swipechip.openReplyOfCount: Reply {{current}} of {{count}}. Show its versions and actions
ui.panels.imagestyleprofileseditor.promp: Preserve prompt text and repeated tags in order. Configured sources are still added, with no grammar or cleanup processing.
